tokens.name: sky-950
tokens.usage: Below the horizon: mountain silhouettes and the deepest scrim. Never a text ground for ink-faint captions longer than a line.

tokens.name: sky-900
tokens.usage: Page ground: the zenith of the night sky and the background of every section.

tokens.name: sky-800
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, the chat panel, slider tracks.

tokens.name: sky-700
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fills, inputs, the user's chat bubble.

tokens.name: sky-600
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines only (card edges, dividers). Too quiet to carry meaning: use line-strong for control borders.

tokens.name: horizon
tokens.usage: The glow where the sky meets the Elqui ridgeline; bottom stop of the sky gradient. Not a surface for ink-faint.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: secondary buttons, inputs, slider ticks. At least 3:1 on sky-950 to sky-700.

tokens.name: milkyway
tokens.usage: Warm dust tint of the Milky Way band, painted in canvas at 4-10% alpha. Never text or UI.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Starlight white. Primary text and star cores on every sky-* surface, horizon and flame-blue-dim (11:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on sky-950 to sky-700, horizon and flame-blue-dim (6.3:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Captions, units and mono labels on sky-950 to sky-700 only (5:1 or better). Not on horizon or flame-blue-dim.

tokens.name: flame-blue
tokens.usage: The microgravity flame. Primary accent: primary button fill, links, focus ring, selected state, the 0 g end of every scale. Text on sky-* (8:1 or better).

tokens.name: flame-blue-dim
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind selected chips and the assistant's cited-source pills; ink or flame-blue text on top.

tokens.name: flame-core
tokens.usage: The white-blue core of a flame and of blue-white stars. Canvas and glows only.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Flame under gravity. The 1 g end of every scale, caution status, the star Gacrux. Text on sky-* (7.7:1 or better). Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: soot
tokens.usage: Sooty yellow glow of a buoyant flame tip. Canvas, and the mid stop of gravity scales. Not a UI state color.

tokens.name: hazard
tokens.usage: Danger and alarm: ignition risk, failed request. Text on sky-* (5.7:1 or better). Always with an icon or the word, never hue alone.

tokens.name: nominal
tokens.usage: Safe / within limits. Sits toward blue so it never depends on telling red from green. Text on sky-* (9:1 or better).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on flame-blue, ember, soot, hazard, nominal and ink fills (6.7:1 or better).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the sky behind the chat panel on small screens and behind modal content.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Floating HUD surfaces over the sky (bot launcher, back button). Text on it follows the sky-800 rules.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The wordmark on the sky and the cover. Once per screen.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.sample: Fire behaves differently when nothing falls.
styles.usage: Section headline after a star zoom.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Sub-section titles and card headlines that need a voice.

styles.name: star-label
styles.usage: Section names beside their star, set in italic like a celestial atlas.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Without buoyancy, hot gases do not rise.
styles.usage: Lead paragraph under a section headline.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A candle flame becomes a slow blue sphere fed by diffusion.
styles.usage: Default reading text and chat messages.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Conducted in the Microgravity Science Glovebox.
styles.usage: Card descriptions, helper text, button labels (weight 500).

styles.name: data-lg
styles.usage: Readout values. Tabular numerals; the unit follows in ink-faint.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, field labels, tags and star designations. Always uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label inside a tag.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between tags; padding inside small controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its control; chat bubble vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding on small screens; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Default card padding; gap between cards; HUD inset from the viewport edge.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between a section headline and its content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Top offset of section content below the back control.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, slider tracks, small square tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, readout tiles, chat bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The chat panel, the simulation viewport, large panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tags, the bot launcher, slider thumbs, source pills.

tokens.name: glow-star
tokens.usage: Halo of a blue-white navigation star at rest.

tokens.name: glow-star-warm
tokens.usage: Halo of Gacrux, the one orange star (Flame lab).

tokens.name: glow-flame
tokens.usage: Hover glow on the primary button and the active slider thumb.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Floating panels over the sky: chat panel, popovers. Cards inside a section use a sky-600 hairline instead.

tokens.name: ring-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring on every interactive element: a sky-900 gap then solid flame-blue (8:1 or better on any sky-* surface).

tokens.name: dur-instant
tokens.usage: Press feedback (scale 0.97) and toggles.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, focus, tooltip and tag state changes.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Popovers, chat messages entering, slider preset jumps.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Chat panel open, section content entering after a zoom.

tokens.name: dur-travel
tokens.usage: The star zoom: the only long animation in the product. The return trip uses dur-travel-back.

tokens.name: dur-travel-back
tokens.usage: The return trip from a section to the sky: the star zoom played backwards.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Anything entering or responding to the user. The default.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Elements already on screen moving from A to B (slider preset jumps, panel resizing).

tokens.name: ease-travel
tokens.usage: The camera during a star zoom: leaves slowly, arrives softly.

tokens.name: z-sky
tokens.usage: Star canvas and Milky Way.

tokens.name: z-horizon
tokens.usage: Elqui ridgeline silhouettes.

tokens.name: z-stars
tokens.usage: Navigation stars and constellation lines.

tokens.name: z-section
tokens.usage: Section content after a zoom.

tokens.name: z-hud
tokens.usage: Wordmark, back control, location caption.

tokens.name: z-bot
tokens.usage: The assistant launcher, always reachable.

tokens.name: z-chat
tokens.usage: The chat panel.
